name: Embed Calendly
description: Easy and simple way to embed Calendly scheduling pages on Drupal.
project_description: Embed Calendly helps you add Calendly scheduling pages to your Drupal website in an easy and simple way. It stores a Calendly API key and organization id, pulls your Calendly event types via the Calendly API, lists them in the admin UI, and one-click generates a full_html custom block containing the Calendly inline-widget embed snippet (assets.calendly.com/external/widget.js) for a chosen event's scheduling URL, which you then place like any other block.
